items.headline: Nielsen is leaning more on wearables to hear what people are watching
items.facts: Nielsen announced it will use data from its partners' wearable devices to improve viewership measurement.

items.headline: Trump says U.S. and Canada reached deal to delay 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports
items.facts: Trump delayed 50% tariffs on Canadian imports after a last‑minute deal with Canada.

items.headline: How Florida quietly removed climate change content from textbooks
items.facts: Florida requested publishers to remove or alter climate change content from high‑school textbooks.
